name: プロデューサー
text:
このあとお茶でもどうだ？
甘いもの食べよう
trans:
How about some tea after this?
We could grab something sweet too.

name: 結華
text:
え？　うん。別にいいけど──あっ違う！
今日アレだ、気を遣ってもらってる！
trans:
Huh? Uh, sure. I don't mind──  Ah, wait!
It's THAT day, right? No wonder you're stepping up!

name: プロデューサー
text: ははっ、まぁうん。ホワイトデーだな
trans: Haha, well yeah. It's White Day.

name: 結華
text:
ええ～……ごめんね先月何もできなかったのに
ありがとう、じゃあ遠慮なくお供します！
trans:
Oh wow... I feel bad that I didn't do anything
last month. But since you're going all out for me,
then I'm gonna milk it! So thanksies!
